criteria.decision: outcome fit>=fit_gate -> prototype_mixture_generalises; colour fit>=fit_gate and outcome fit<=fit_low -> colour_supervision_unlocks_mixture; colour colour-acc>=colour_gate -> colour_learned_centroid_path_broken; colour colour-acc<=colour_low -> colour_head_cannot_learn; else inconclusive_prototype
criteria.arms: outcome sees the 4-way answer only; colour also sees the colour named in the request string, which is public and inside the request
criteria.selection: six learned prototypes plus a six-way query classifier; the answer is the class of sum_c p_c centroid_c, so no discrete switch remains
criteria.abstention: null = b + presence * sum_c p_c min_i ||pixel_i - proto_c||^2

control_arms.p3_24: soft centroid with a bilinear score: train 0.250, fit 0.250
control_arms.p3_26: density arms withdrawn before freeze; five escapes documented

amendment_pre_freeze.when: after pricing, before any card reading
amendment_pre_freeze.what: a 600-step trial of the single-arm design showed the six-way classifier at chance (train 0.188, fit 0.156) and the 4-way answer at chance, which would have produced query_colour_not_learned and mis-stated the cause, since the query provably decodes colour at 1.000/1.000
amendment_pre_freeze.change: split into two arms: outcome only, and colour (the 4-way answer plus the colour named in the request); the verdict ladder now separates cannot-represent from supervision-does-not-reach
amendment_pre_freeze.unchanged: candidate, prototypes, readout, data, order, optimiser, doses
